caption: The drawing depicts a clear, faceted glass goblet with a broad, round bowl, a short stem that includes a baluster-shaped node, and a wide circular base. The goblet is rendered in shades of gray with precise shading to represent its transparent material and reflective surfaces. Etched or engraved onto the surface of the bowl is a decorative pattern featuring grape clusters, grape leaves, and curling vines, all finely detailed in a light gray tone. Below the goblet, there is a flat, segmented design which appears to be a detailed reference for the decorative pattern, showing the same grapes, leaves, and vine motifs stretched out horizontally across a series of vertical sections that correspond to the facets of the glass. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the overall composition centers the goblet with the accompanying pattern directly beneath it.
title: Goblet
